set.name: Slider
set.description: Range input for picking a number between a minimum and maximum. Thick pill track; the filled Range is a pill too and holds a white pill thumb inside with a 2px inset. Locale=EN|FA, Size=Small|Medium (track 20/24, thumb 24x16 / 28x20), Position=25|50|75 (where the thumb sits; pick the closest one, the real position comes from the value in code). Focus looks like Default: the code draws the neutral focus ring. Show value displays the current value text at the end of the label row (Value / Value (FA) are free text, e.g. "12 h"). In RTL the whole control mirrors: the range fills from the right and the thumb moves left as the value grows. Designed at 320 wide: the filled Range has a fixed width, so keep instances at 320.
